claim: Additional relevant hooks: experimental.compaction.autocontinue (control auto-continue), experimental.chat.system.transform (modify system prompt), experimental.chat.messages.transform (rewrite message history)

Phase 2 topic-structured compaction reduces total tokens by 20.3% (857,115 baseline → 683,522 plugin), input tokens by 20.7%, output tokens by 17.7%. Model: github-copilot/claude-sonnet-4, 21 messages across 3 interleaved topics.

Primary savings mechanism is API call reduction (89 vs 140, -36.4%), not summary compression. Topic-structured compaction causes the model to produce more focused, consolidated responses with fewer intermediate tool-call chains. Cache reads dropped 49.9% (10.6M → 5.3M). Wall time 39.4% faster (49min → 30min).

Recall quality preserved: both baseline and plugin produced accurate answers to 3 recall questions across topics. Plugin answers slightly more concise. Zero errors in plugin run vs 1 timeout in baseline. Peak context similar (151K vs 148K), both triggered 2 compactions.
